shares spiked on Tuesday after the U.S. FDA approved a new manufacturing process for Simlandi, a biosimilar the company markets with Teva Pharmaceutical
With the approval, the company will be permitted to add Process 2.0 for the production of adalimumab drug substance in its newly approved DSM2 manufacturing suite in Reykjavik, Iceland, Alvotech

The new process, which has the potential to more than double the drug substance output per batch without impacting product quality, “is a significant achievement that reflects the expertise of our process development and manufacturing teams,” said Chief Operating Officer Joseph McClellan.
